ev_0005.summary: Figure: large circle centered at O (303.5,264.3), r=236.0, with diameter AB on the horizontal line y=264 (A at 67.4, B at 539.7 on the large circle, so O is the midpoint of AB). Small circle centered at B (539.7,264.3), r=94.5, meets the large circle at C (~520.7,172) and D (~520.7,357). Solid chord F-E passes through O (F at 86.4,357 on large circle; E at 486,186 on small circle; collinear check: line FE hits x=303.5 at y=264.1). Dashed segment E-B is a radius of the small circle (CV-confirmed, 4 dashes). C-B is expected as a dashed radius but was not CV-detected. Point P (445.2,264) is the leftmost point of the small circle, on segment AB, unlabeled. No right angles verified.
